about: Receiving-water names in North Dakota's records (DEQ's harmful algal bloom listing, read 2026-11-14) that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for ND, by name as typed, with the counties DEQ gives (a same-named lake elsewhere in the state is not the one listed: North Dakota has more than one Clear Lake and Buffalo Lake). DEQ's archive of incidents 1975-2020 names no water: its 36 sewage reports are placed by their own points or listed with their county.

left_out.name: (none)
left_out.reason: DEQ's incident archive gives a point and a county, no water name
